notes.title: Version 1.0.02
notes.notes:
Armor shows remaining strength in numbers
Fix ponies stuck underground
Ability to use a teleport scroll on a pony
All scrolls are created on the magic table
Corrections in the text
Some other small fixes

notes.title: Future changes 2
notes.notes:
The following updates will contain these changes:

[list]
[*] Fruits/flowers will fall from the trees upon the first strike
[*] When digging up the soil, there will be a chance to dig up a worm, stone or ore
[*] The water filter will be simpler, it will not require a fire and iron
[*] We are going to add a stone smelter to melt ores (for example: iron and gold) hence, the mini forge will be used for other crafting purposes (for example: other blueprints and glass items)
[*] Diana will give simple recipes for cooking on a campfire
[*] A new Recipe Merchant will be available, so the player can buy other blueprints, such as: Terrarium for breeding worms, rain canopy, advanced dish recipes, etc.
[/list]

You can leave your comments under this post ^^

notes.title: Future changes on the first island.
notes.notes:
We are actively working on the next island, but we will not stop updating and improving the first island.
At the request of players, the next update will include the following changes:
[list]
[*] Endurance scale for fast running of the character.
[*] Fast running of horses, with increased consumption of their food.
[*] Blacksmith with recipes for forge, iron ingot, and iron tools. On the second second island there will also be a blacksmith, but with different recipes.
[*] Help tips in the form of a window with animation. They will help you during the game.
[*] Vendor of additional recipes to help you survive. For example: baked apple, fried mushroom, garden fence, etc.
[/list]

Leave your wishes in discussions, group chat https://s.team/chat/B4aEwlt9 or send to thefarawaylandgame@gmail.com. We listen to everyone and will be happy to communicate!

notes.title: Version: 0.2.01
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648661/d2f4e6fa1235fe1afe94cc509881b94394074ac3.png[/img]
Crafting items is now more convenient. Within a recipe, you can create its ingredients.
Such items are marked in orange.
You can also go to the ingredients page by clicking the button with the "magnifying glass" symbol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648661/a78400870ff2ce4acbdfffc904293c369ad0d9cf.png[/img]
Now, when a tool, torch or armor breaks, it is automatically replaced with the same one from the inventory.

notes.title: Version: 0.1.03
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40648661/c1b428f5320f8c065e0b15eae3628cb4853cab8f.png[/img]
[i]Version: 0.1.03[/i]

[b]New feature: [/b]
•	In the game settings, it became possible to re-bind keys 
[b]Changes: [/b]
•	Damage of stone arrows and stone knife is now slightly higher 
•	HP of trees, stones and irises is now slightly less
•	The nettle rope recipe is now available at the start, and the street lamp can be obtained through further quests

•	Iron torch burns longer
